summary.text: Seth Sauer-Hart is the Democratic candidate for South Carolina House of Representatives District 37 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against Republican incumbent Steven Long.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he works as a Supply Chain Specialist after a career mainly in the automotive industry.

paragraphs.text: Seth Sauer-Hart earned a high school diploma from Mauldin High School and a bachelor's degree from the University of South Carolina in 2011.
In his 2026 Ballotpedia survey, he said he was raised mainly in Woodruff and Mauldin, has lived in South Carolina almost his whole life, and now lives in Inman with his wife and 5-year-old son.
He said he decided to run because voters in the district had not had a choice in their representation for over eight years.

Sauer-Hart said his campaign messages include basing legislation on evidence and scientific research, lowering everyday costs such as healthcare and child care, and raising wages for essential workers such as teachers.
